newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Thirteen stocks rose, one fell and nine were flat in 10.8-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Wednesday with the WIG 20 index up 0.6 percent to 1,532 points.
The remaining seven stocks did not trade.
The National Investment Fund NIF index was flat at 131.3 points in 1.1-million-zloty trade.
NFI units rose 0.4 percent to 130.5 zlotys in a 4.7-million-zloty turnover.
